----------------
--DIMENSION DATE
----------------
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.DimDate
WITH 
(
    LOCATION = 'DimDate',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET
) AS
select 
    Datakey,
    [Date],
    [Day],
    [Month],
    [Year]
from silver.retail;

select * from silver.retail;
----------------
--DIMENSION PRODUCT
----------------

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.DimProduct
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'DimProduct',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET
)  AS
SELECT
    ABS(CHECKSUM(Product)) AS ProductKey,
    Product
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(Product) AS Product
    FROM silver.retail
    WHERE Product IS NOT NULL
) p;



select * from gold.DimProduct;

----------------
--DIMENSION Customer
----------------
select * from silver.retail;

create EXTERNAL table gold.DimCustomer
with 
(
    LOCATION = 'DimCustomer',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET
)as 
select
    abs(checksum(Customer_name)) as CustomerKey,
    Customer_name,
    Customer_category from 
(
select 
    DISTINCT
    trim(customer_name) as Customer_name ,
    trim(customer_category)as Customer_category
from silver.retail
where customer_name is not null
)c;

select * from gold.dimcustomer;


----------------
--DIMENSION Store
----------------
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.DimStore
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'DimStore/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = Parquet
)
AS
SELECT
    ABS(CHECKSUM(City, Store_Type)) AS StoreKey,
    City,
    Store_Type
FROM
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TRIM(City)       AS City,
        TRIM(Store_Type) AS Store_Type
    FROM silver.retail
    WHERE City IS NOT NULL
) s;

select * from gold.DimStore;



----------------
--DIMENSION Production
----------------
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.DimPromotion
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'DimPromotion/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = Parquet
)
AS
SELECT
    ABS(CHECKSUM(Promotion, Discount_Applied)) AS PromotionKey,
    Promotion,
    Discount_Applied
FROM
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TRIM(Promotion)         AS Promotion,
        TRIM(Discount_Applied)  AS Discount_Applied
    FROM silver.retail
    WHERE Promotion IS NOT NULL
) p;
